_comment: Tool-facing hardware declaration for the Atari Tempest PCB (MOS 6502, color VECTOR / QuadraScan).
Read from MAME atari/tempest.cpp: main_map@488, machine config@640-661, INPUT_PORTS@523, clock_r@401,
irq set_periodic_int@644; and devices/video/avgdvg.cpp (AVG_TEMPEST). Numbers decimal (JSON has no 0x);
'_hex'/'_note' fields are annotations the loader ignores. VECTOR display: no tilemap/framebuffer -- the
6502 builds a display list in vector RAM, the AVG walks it, and the render is byte-exact vs MAME's
headless AVI (480x640). See boards/tempest/{avg.js,vector-raster.js} and scratch machine-notes.md.
_cpu_note: MOS 6502 @ MASTER_CLOCK(12.096MHz)/8 = 1.512MHz. No bus contention (unlike centiped).

screen._note: VECTOR. The AVI/render target is 480x640 (MAME render.cpp:1609 hard-coded vector visarea 640x480, swapped by ROT270). set_size(400,300)/set_visarea(0,580,0,570) do NOT set the frame size. ROT270 is baked into the render transform (vector-raster.js), so the 480x640 frame is already display-oriented.

stateRegions.name: colorram
stateRegions._hex: 0x0800-0x080F color RAM (avg:colorram, write-only; shadowed). Render input. -- @491

_stateregion_note: dump order (dump_state.lua / memory.dumpState): workram, then vectorram, then colorram. 'base' is the CPU address; colorram's out-of-order base reflects that it dumps LAST.
_rw_differ_note: 0x5000 W = watchdog clear + IRQ ack (no read). 0x6040 R = mathbox status, W = EAROM control -- different devices.

readRanges.name: in1
readRanges._hex: 0x0D00 IN1 (spinner knob b0-3 + cabinet dip b4)

readRanges.name: pokey1
readRanges._hex: 0x60C0-0x60CF POKEY1 read (pots=input ADC / RANDOM) -- UNIMPLEMENTED: THROWS

writeRanges.name: pokey1
writeRanges._hex: 0x60C0-0x60CF POKEY1 write -- recorded to io sink (§5 audio)

writeRanges.name: pokey2
writeRanges._hex: 0x60D0-0x60DF POKEY2 write -- recorded to io sink (§5 audio)

_inputs_note: IN0 (0x0C00) MIXED polarity: b0 coin3, b1 coin2, b2 coin1, b3 tilt, b4 self-test, b5 diag-step -- all ACTIVE-LOW (idle 1); b6 AVG done_r (ACTIVE-HIGH, 0=busy default); b7 3kHz clock = (total_cycles & 0x100). Idle IN0 = 0x3F. The SPINNER is a 4-bit rotary at IN1 (0x0D00) b0-3; FIRE/SUPERZAPPER read via POKEY pots -- input wiring pending grounding.

IN0._bits: b0-5 active-low idle high; b6 AVG done; b7 3kHz. tempest.cpp:523-534.

_controlByte_note: Program ROM base is 0x9000 (not 0x2000 like centiped). The config-cert reads the reset-vector target at 0xFFFC and the first program byte; pending a MAME golden probe (mame_golden 6502 path assumes ROM@0x2000 -- vector-game golden tooling is a §2 item).

interrupt._vectors_hex: 6502 vectors at 0xFFFA (NMI), 0xFFFC (RESET), 0xFFFE (IRQ/BRK) -- 0xF000-0xFFFF is a reload of the 0xD000 program ROM.
interrupt._note: PERIODIC IRQ at CLOCK_3KHZ/12 = 12.096MHz/4096/12 = 246.09Hz (tempest.cpp:644 set_periodic_int(irq0_line_assert)). One IRQ every 1512000/246.09 = 6144 CPU cycles (= 4.10 IRQs/frame). Acked by write to 0x5000 (wdclr_w -> CLEAR_LINE). NOT vblank-tied; there is NO vblank NMI. Frame sync is via the AVG done_r poll (IN0 bit6) + the 3kHz bit. Watchdog = CLOCK_3KHZ/256 ~= 11.5Hz.
